policy.candidate_rule: numeric occurrence followed by one of the evidence-ledger units

classifications.excluded_context: candidate inside fenced code or an HTML comment, or the 0x prefix of a numeric encoding; exclusion is recorded
classifications.provenance_bound: the candidate agrees with a numeric figure annotation attached to the same prose block
classifications.unbound: ordinary Markdown prose with no agreeing attached figure annotation

policy.corpus_digest: sha256(canonical JSON of the documents array)

unbound_triage.external: an externally sourced value, with the source named by its triage rule
unbound_triage.missing_producer: a load-bearing result for which no machine-readable producer is known
unbound_triage.normative_or_example: a contract value, algebraic notation, or worked example rather than an empirical result
unbound_triage.produced: a known producer exists but the figure still lacks a resolving annotation
unbound_triage.untriaged: not yet reviewed; no evidence claim is made
